GhostAbout: Read receipts and typing are invisible to others; a missing online status is noticeable. The switch in the side menu toggles all four at once.
SpyAboutSaving: Deleted messages stay in the chat with a mark; earlier texts of edited ones open from the message menu. Only text is kept: media is gone once the chat reloads.
SpyAboutBots: Bots rewrite and delete their messages constantly, so they are skipped by default.
MarksAbout: Empty means the default. Messages already on screen update as they are redrawn.
SeeGramAbout: Telegram Desktop that keeps quiet about you and remembers what others erase.
NothingSaved: No deleted messages have been saved in this chat yet.
ClearConfirm: Clear the deleted messages kept in this chat?
SeeTgAbout: Adds a see.tg view to the gifts tab of a profile: NFT and regular gifts, hidden ones included, with filters and sorting. Signs in through @seetgbot on its own.
SeeTgSignedOut: Signed out of see.tg, the next request signs in again.
SeeTgFilterHint: Names as on see.tg, several separated by commas.
SeeTgErrorAuth: Could not sign in to see.tg.
SeeTgErrorRate: Too many requests, try again in a minute.
SeeTgErrorPremium: This view needs see.tg or Telegram Premium.
SeeTgResolveByUsername: By username, up to 200 a day
SeeTgResolveAbout: Via a gift: find an owner’s NFT on see.tg, then request that gift from Telegram to obtain profile data
SeeTgWhoIsFailed: Could not find out who that is.
SeeTgHistoryLimitDay: Free requests are over for today. With see.tg Premium there is no limit.
SeeTgHistoryLimitProfile: You have opened this profile's history too many times today. With see.tg Premium there is no limit.
SeeTgHistoryHiddenText: The owner hides their history with see.tg Premium.
SeeTgHistoryTransfersHiddenText: The owner hides their transfers from this profile's history.
SeeTgHistoryHiddenEventText: A participant hides their history with see.tg Premium.
SeeTgHistorySavedBack: Gift is back on the profile
SeeTgHistorySavedGoneHint: Hidden, upgraded or converted to stars. Telegram does not say which.
SeeTgPremiumVerificationDescription: This account has a see.tg Premium subscription.
SeeTgResolveAdvanced: For advanced users. If you are unsure what peer resolution does, keep the default settings.
StickersRange: From {min} to {max} stickers. Default: {default}. Server mode shows the entire received list.
AboutSummary: An independent Telegram Desktop fork with ghost mode, message history and see.tg integration.
AboutSeeTg: Gifts, profile history, badges and comments from the see.tg miniapp, right in the client.
AboutHistory: History is stored on this device: only messages and edits received by this client are available.
UpdatesStartupAbout: Checks immediately when SeeGram starts. Requires automatic updates to be enabled.
ScheduledMessagesAbout: Sends messages after about 12 seconds to help avoid appearing online. Independent of the ghost mode switch.
SelfDestructMediaAbout: Shows media without sending a view receipt. Choose “View” in the message menu to mark it as viewed and start its timer.
MuteScheduledNotificationsAbout: Do not notify when ghost mode automatically scheduled messages are sent. Regular scheduled messages are unaffected.
SeeTgGiftsAbout: A tab for see.tg gifts, including hidden gifts
SeeTgTransfersAbout: History of gifts sent and received
GiftBatchAbout: Up to 9 catalog gifts at once, with shared or separate messages
GiftBatchCommentsAbout: Off: use one message for all gifts
GiftBatchStopAbout: Sent one at a time. Stops on error
GiftHiddenAbout: Show gifts missing from the Telegram catalogue, available through see.tg
GiftHiddenEmpty: No hidden gifts are available to buy yet
GiftGridAbout: Choose gifts for the cells. Gifts are sent from the end: right to left, bottom to top. Empty cells are skipped
GiftGridSetting: Arrange gifts in a grid with individual messages and extra rows
SeeTgGiftDetailsAbout: Show the see.tg estimate in TON and purchase links to external marketplaces
SeeTgEstimateAbout: The estimate combines sales of this gift, similar models and backdrops, floor prices and the collectible value of its number. These are market references, not a guaranteed sale price.
SeeTgMarketPreviewsAbout: Show external marketplace prices on gift cards in the Telegram and see.tg tabs
DoubleBottomAbout: Your main passcode opens all accounts and these settings. Other passcodes open only the accounts you assign to them.
ProfilePasswordOptional: New passcode (leave empty to keep current)
ProfileDrag: Drag an account onto a group, or open a group to select accounts.
ProfileDeleteAbout: Delete this passcode group? Accounts will remain accessible with your main passcode.
ProfileError: Choose at least one account and use a unique passcode.
ProfilePasswordNeeded: Set your main local passcode before creating groups.
ProfileMainAbout: Opens every account. Unlock with this passcode to manage groups.
